label: TP
reason: User input from query string flows directly to printf format string via doSomething -> bar variable. The code uses printf(bar, ...) which allows format specifier injection (e.g., %n, %{...}) bypassing any potential content sanitization. The intermediate HashMap usage does not sanitize the string; it merely reassigns it. The decode step decodes URL-encoded characters but does not strip malicious format specifiers. This is a classic format string vulnerability pattern.

evidence.note: printf(bar, ...) sinks tainted user input directly enabling format string attacks
